fichas.title: Multi-storey Car Park Regulations
fichas.summary: Regulations and design guidance for multi-storey car parks cover usable-area categories, underground location, access and escape, clear heights, ventilation openings, circulation, urban integration and safe operation. Diagrams show an office-integrated car park, access-ramp layouts and parking-space arrangements. A table gives sanitary-facility guidance for supervisory and maintenance staff and users.
uses: Office use integrated into the façade or ground floor
furniture_equipment: Sanitary fixtures: WC, washbasin, bucket sink and urinals
